changelog.notes: Schema 2.0. Block renamed to site. Harmonised variable names, units and English descriptions. Country and crop added to site data. Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3. Coordinates checked against country borders. rank_analysis left empty, to be filled by the data managers.

study.title: IITA_TRICOT DEMO
study.description: On-farm trials implemented under the scope of AVISA and 1000FARMS projects to test new cowpea varieties on-farm.

location_privacy.method: Each site displaced to a random point within a fixed radius, reproducible per site id. Sites published in release v1 keep their v1 coordinates.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept as adm1 to adm3, capitalisation standardised
